I'm a white woman, late 30's, combo skin, no acne issues, but lots of redness and some rosecea bumps when i have a bad flare. Save your money on this one.
Great product. I have alot or redness I'm my cheeks and it really have improved with this product

This is BY FAR the best product I have ever used. It has almost completely obliterated my rosacea. I am a little bit different than most rosacea sufferers because my skin is EXTREMELY oily for a woman in her forties, and the oil seemed to make the redness and inflammation worse. This product is not at all greasy and has really calmed my skin down a lot. I will be devastated if this product ever gets discontinued. It also is one of the few products available that contains carnosine, which is so powerful for anti-aging.

I used this for a good month despite realizing about a week in there was no short term benefit in hopes that maybe there was a longer term benefit. I saw zero benefit of this product and I actually saw some issues in using it, namely that it gets very pilly with any makeup applied or other treatments like face lotion. Product does not layer well with other products, it slides off almost immediately when another liquid is applied over or under it.
I find i have to use foundation bc if not my skin gets patchy red and irratated. Since having this product, my skin feels soothed and redness 90 improved. That is a big deal to me.
this serum is lightweight and does exactly what it says it does. i gets rid of redness with irritating my sensitive skin. it layers perfectly with my other skincare products. i highly recommend

I have roscea and the redness i experience isnt on the extreme end, but it still happens. I also have sensitive, dry acne prone skin all in which makes it even more difficult to find products that work for me especially for improving my roscea. Found this product and I started with just wearing in the am and it works amazing. Very conditioning for my dry skin but also helps with the redness. Ive experienced not sensitivity to this product either its very gentle and if you're experiencing a roscea flare it helps calm the skin in my experience. Highly recommend!

I have been using Bye Bye Redness Serum for over a month. Unfortunately the only thing g that has gone Bye Bye was the money I paid for the serum. It has done absolutely nothing to reduce the redness in my complexion. I would give zero stars if that were an option.

I think this is working/helping reduce the red irritation I've been battling on my skin. At first, I might have over applied and my skin became even more red (gah!) but I took a 24 hour break and then started applying a little bit both in the morning and the evening (one squirt). Now I'm on Day 10 and my face doesn't hurt and the red is almost gone. Fingers crossed this continues

I have Rosacea and this serum helps a lot with soothing my skin and reducing redness. It also feels hydrating. I have found it is most effective when used 2x daily. Also tips for if you have Rosacea: one product isn't going to magically get rid of it. That doesn't mean it doesn't work. You have to do a lot of trial & error work with reducing Rosacea appaerance and flare ups. You have to find and limit triggers as well.

Ok, so first time using I used in conjunction with Hey Honey Relax! Moisturizer (also for the first time). So not sure if it is one or the other or both. I used both after using my exfolikate by kate somerville. The exfoliator is great at clearing pores and getting rid of dead/flaky skin asap. However, my face is irritated (red, hotish, stinging) afterwards. I use it for the amount of time and dont scrub super hard. I also use a benzoyl peroxide cleanser as i have cystic acne from PCOS (salicylic does nothing). I used this before moisturizer and patted (not rub) into my face. Felt good (not sticky, watery, or fragrant) absorbed well and quickly and once dried followed with hey honey moisturizer. My face felt so cool and calm after! Usually my face feels irritated the rest of the night after exfoliating. Im pretty sure i have rosacea. Redness definitely calmed down prior to using. Excited to see results after using for 30 days (skin cell turnover takes 28-40 days, thats when you would see the most benefit from a face product). Hope this helps!

While it feels nice going on, rhats about it… didnt do anything to rame redness (i dont have rosacea just naturally pink cheeks) and it was really disappointing after all the reviews and marketing saying it would work

avis.titre: Works on this Sensitive Skin Girly
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and red dry patches around my nose and lip area. This serum does exactly what it claims it does. I'm able to wear this serum under makeup and doesn't pill or mess with my makeup. On days I don't wear makeup, this serum makes my skin glow.

newer to the rosacea skin game (thanks to mid 30s women hormones). I've been trying to use my regular routine in denial. finally took the plunge and wow, my skin is SO relieved and redness is reduced. I still have flair ups due to hot temps, spicy foods, etc. this is not a cover up. it does reduce the normal redness and makes the skin not hot / irritated feeling. very calming. it feels like my skin barrier is helped. recommend other items to cover up for a makeup look. this is so much more 'natural' with red reduced but pink tint still coming through. it doesn't make my skin green like others have. for reference I have fair Nordic/irish skin with around nose/cheek focused rosacea
This cream gave me rash on my skin. I'm not recommended. I'm not sensitive skin.

I really don't know what's there that is so effective, but I woke up to a less irritated skin in the morning after one time using it! Very much recommended.
My skin is very sensitive to heat and dryness. I use this on those days where I know my skin needs extra love. It works to hydrate and moisturize plus reduce irritation. I wil buy this again.

avis.titre: I was skeptical, but it works!

avis.titre: BYB BYE Redness Concentrated Derma Serum

Great redness relief serum that counteracts pink and red tones but it's light under makeup or any other moisturizer you use. Great for every day use, and feels great on skin.

avis.titre: Bye Bye Redness, Hello Radiant Skin!
avis.texte: I recently tried out the Bye Bye Redness Serum by IT Cosmetics, and let me tell you, it's a game-changer! This serum contains one percent colloidal oatmeal, which really helps soothe the skin. Plus, it has neutralizing green that instantly reduces redness. And those skin-soothing peptides? They're a great addition! But here's the best part: it actually works! In just one week, I noticed a 20% reduction in the appearance of redness. Talk about impressive results! It's so satisfying to see a product deliver on its promises. Overall, I highly recommend the Bye Bye Redness Serum. It not only says bye-bye to redness but also hello to radiant skin! Give it a try and see the difference it can make. You won't be disappointed!

A little goes a long way! I was very impressed with how it evened my skin tone out and got rid of my daily redness. I found that I didn't need to layer on my foundation when I used Bye Bye Redness, it truly does what it says on the jar. I also tried this without my foundation and it worked great. I used my moisturizer and Bye Bye Redness and my skin looked great till I washed my face that evening. I am giving this to family members for their stocking stuffers.
I received this product for review, it did nothing for my redness , IT cosmetics was better before Jamie sold it. Since then all the products aren't the same.

The IT bye bye redness was used by my husband and I both as he has much more redness than I do but it didn't help his much. Mine comes and goes because I have sensitive skin. This product didn't cause any issues. It's definitely worth a try and helps

avis.titre: Say Bye Bye to Redness! It works!
avis.texte: BzzAgent sent me It Cosmetics ByeBye Redness serum to try, and being someone with facial redness issues, I was thrilled! I have not tried this brand before, but have heard good things about it. I used the serum morning and evening and almost immediately noticed the redness on my face diminish little by little. It's really hard to find a good redness control product, especially an effective one, and Bye Bye redness made me a believer in the It brand. My skin not only had less redness, it felt really good as well. The texture and tone of my skin improved and my friends and family even noticed a difference! I am thrilled with this product and know that you will be, too!

Overall I'm happy with this product. I'm very fair skinned and have some redness, especially when it's cold outside and old acne marks flare up. I have been using this as a base and it helps to even out my skin tone so I don't have to rely on full coverage makeup.
Winter makes my cheeks especially red, the dryness always does it. This serum was very hydrating and calming. My skin feels really soft after using it, and it pairs well with any of my moisturizers!

The IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Redness Serum is a great product for facial redness! I recieved this product for free from Bzzagent in exchange for my honest opinion. I normally have dry skin that can often experience that annoying redness. While trying the serum, I noticed the serum was lightweight and offered good hydration during Wisconsin's cold winter. It terms of correcting the redness in my skin, to my surprise, I noticed the redness in my face started to fade within about 2 weeks of using the serum. The color of the serum helps to offset the redness in my skin. I've been using IT Cosmetics products for over 4 years, and they are all great trust worthy products that perform as promised. All in all, in my experience, this is a great light weight serum that does what it says. I would recommend this product to friends and family that struggle with facial redness.
